summary: Beacon Topco, Inc. (Topco) filed an 8-K reporting the October 31, 2026 Third Amendment to its September 29, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc (Beacon), Merger Sub, and Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. The amendment resets the closing deadline and Section 10.1(b) End Date to November 13, 2026. Topco already acquired Beacon via a UK scheme of arrangement sanctioned September 1, 2026; the remaining step is the Delaware merger of Merger Sub into Clywedog, which survives as a wholly owned Topco subsidiary. No price, premium, or consideration terms were restated. Watch final Clywedog closing execution before the November 13 outside date.
